channel.title: Holistic Life: Fitness and Wellness Gift Ideas
channel.description: Fitness and Wellness Gift Ideas guides from Holistic Life.

item.title: Gifts for Him Who Works Out at Home: A Simple Home Gym Checklist
item.description: Gifts for him, or for her, when they work out at home, in a checklist you can screenshot. Each pick is compact enough for a small room, with notes on what to check before you buy. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Gifts for Her or Him: What to Buy a Walker Instead of Shoes
item.description: Gifts for her or him that work better than guessing a shoe size. Think cushioned socks, warm layers and gear that helps walkers be seen on dark winter evenings, plus a gift card idea for walking shoes. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Kitchen Gift Basket Ideas: What to Put In for Someone Who Meal Preps
item.description: Kitchen gift basket ideas for busy cooks, in a checklist you can save. Glass containers, sheet pans, a sharp knife, a thermometer and more, with notes on what to look for and three baskets to build. A nurse-run guide. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Stocking Stuffers for Men and Women Who Work Out: A Quick Checklist
item.description: Stocking stuffers for men and women who work out, in a quick checklist. Loop bands, a jump rope, a massage ball and more, all small enough to wrap and useful the same day. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Gym Gift Basket for Him or Her: 10 Home Gym Gifts for Small Spaces
item.description: A gym gift basket for him or her starts with gear that fits the space. Ten home gym gifts for small spaces, from adjustable dumbbells to a thick mat and a foldable bench, with what to look for before you buy. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Gifts for Mom She Will Actually Use: Wellness and Comfort Ideas
item.description: Gifts for mom that are not clutter: cozy layers, a yoga mat, a plush robe and more. Wellness, comfort and movement ideas, with what to look for in each one, from a nurse-run site. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Christmas Gifts for Women and Men Who Love to Walk: A Simple Checklist
item.description: Christmas gifts for women and men who love to walk, made simple: cushioned socks, clip-on lights, an insulated bottle, warm layers and more. A nurse-run checklist with what to look for in each one, so you buy something that gets used. Guide contains affiliate links.
